headline: Brazilian Court Grants Supermarket Operator GPA 72-Month Labor Debt Settlement
summary: Brazilian judicial authorities authorized Grupo Pão de Açúcar (GPA) to settle its outstanding labor obligations across 72 monthly installments.
why: GPA is one of Brazil's largest food retail chains, currently operating under extrajudicial restructuring procedures.

impacts.name: GPA
impacts.why: Court approved GPA to pay labor debts in 72 installments during extrajudicial recovery.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
